description: The same old-row growth on a table whose Text column was added by the fixture (Bo2, 60 Yes/No-only rows written before the column existed): one old row (the 31st) gets a 100-character Tx through a table recordset. Asks the page and neighbours' change when the column is already in the descriptor. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it.
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2-pres-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
